## Installation Instructions

1. Download the experimental build of [UE4SS](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases) (as of writing, use the `experimental-latest`).
2. Extract the UE4SS files into `Project Silverfish/SilverFish/Binaries/Win64`.
3. Extract the `ItemTranslationMod` folder from this `.zip` file into `Project Silverfish/SilverFish/Binaries/Win64/ue4ss/Mods`.
4. Make sure that `enabled.txt` is present inside `ItemTranslationMod`.

## Configuration

Edit `settings.txt` inside the `ItemTranslationMod` folder to configure your language code and optional debug mode. Translation dictionaries go in the `Translations` folder.
